name: Builder — Single Prototype Pipeline
description: Grill → build → handoff for one prototype. Each idea runs this independently.

nodes.body_template:
Score: ${trigger.score}/25 | Slug: ${trigger.slug}

A dossier exists at ~/vault/ventures/ideas/${trigger.slug}.md — read it first.

YOUR JOB — Grill ONLY. Do NOT build the prototype (that is the next card).

1. Grill with REAL PO using self-grill skill (REQUIRED — answer as founder).
   - CRITICAL: env -u HERMES_KANBAN_TASK before launching PO (see grill-rpc-ops skill)
   - Persist grill output to ~/projects/${trigger.slug}/context/ (per-branch files)
   - Run validation: bash ~/.hermes-teams/shared-skills/self-grill/scripts/validate-grill-output.sh ${trigger.slug}
2. Write grill decisions summary to ~/projects/${trigger.slug}/.context/grill/decisions.md
3. Copy dossier to ~/projects/${trigger.slug}/.context/dossier.md

Complete this card when grill validation passes.
Do NOT build the prototype — that is the next card.
NEVER put artifacts in ~/vault/ (Obsidian only). Everything goes in ~/projects/${trigger.slug}/.

Slug: ${trigger.slug}

OBSERVED BEHAVIOR: Builders consistently skip loop_engine and build directly.
This is the #1 known failure mode. You will be tempted to skip it. DO NOT.

The venture-prototype skill says (line 132): "The builder self-assesses every build as 'simple enough' to skip loop_engine. This is premature completion every time."

GATE: Your work will be automatically checked. If loop_engine was not called, the card will be marked FAILED and re-dispatched.

REQUIRED:
1. Read ~/projects/${trigger.slug}/context/*.md
2. Write /tmp/verify-${trigger.slug}.py (20+ checks)
3. Call loop_engine (MANDATORY) with 2 phases — see venture-prototype skill lines 156-180 for the exact call
4. Write README and handoff

You are not special. Your build is not simple enough. Call loop_engine.
NEVER put artifacts in ~/vault/.

Write review handoff for: ${trigger.name}

Prototype at ~/projects/${trigger.slug}/prototype/
Grill decisions at ~/projects/${trigger.slug}/context/

1. Update ~/vault/ventures/portfolio.md 'Awaiting Review' section
2. Post kanban comment on the build card:
   - Prototype path, README path, grill decisions path
   - Aha moment, decisions to challenge

Complete when portfolio updated and comment posted.
